selected_script.angle: greasy range hood filter smeared worse by wet paper towel
selected_script.hook: Extreme close-up of a sticky brown grease patch on a metal range hood filter while a wet paper towel drags through it and leaves cloudy streaks instead of removing it.

timeline.0-3s: Extreme close-up on a real kitchen range hood filter or metal hood underside with sticky yellow-brown grease. A hand tries the familiar ordinary method: a damp paper towel with a little dish soap. The towel drags through the grease but only makes a cloudy smear and leaves lint stuck in the residue.
timeline.3-6s: The same hand keeps scrubbing the same spot with the paper towel, pressing harder. The grease spreads wider into dull streaks, the paper towel wrinkles and looks saturated, and the hand pauses in visible frustration over the still-greasy metal surface.
timeline.6-10s: The NUAN Heavy Duty Kitchen Degreaser Spray enters naturally from the counter. Show the exact white curved plastic trigger spray bottle with white trigger nozzle, white ribbed collar, green front label, black NUAN logo near the top, Heavy Duty Degreaser label text, peach scent badge/icon, and correct 500ml proportions. The hand sprays foam onto the same greasy area, waits briefly, then wipes with a plain blue microfiber towel. Finish on a stable close-up of the same area: one side still dull and smeared, the cleaned strip visibly brighter with grease removed. Light spoken CTA: 'If your paper towel just spreads grease around, try this on the hood.'

scenes.promptText: Create one complete approximately 10-second vertical 9:16 TikTok-style UGC cleaning-product ad, realistic handheld phone-shot in a normal home kitchen with natural light, no polished commercial look. Use one continuous scene only. 0-3s: start with an extreme close-up of a credible cleaning pain on a metal range hood filter or underside of a range hood: sticky yellow-brown kitchen grease collected in the mesh grooves and along the metal edge. A real hand uses a familiar ordinary method, a damp paper towel with a little dish soap, rubbing the grease. The paper towel visibly fails: it drags through the grease, leaves cloudy gray-brown smears, lint bits, and a dull oily film. This opening must be understandable with no audio. 3-6s: continue the same failed method on the same exact greasy spot from a close handheld angle. The hand presses harder and scrubs back and forth, but the grease spreads wider into streaks, the paper towel wrinkles, darkens, and starts tearing slightly, and the person gives a small frustrated pause. Show extra effort and worsening residue, not comedy and not unsafe behavior. 6-10s: the NUAN Heavy Duty Kitchen Degreaser Spray enters naturally from the kitchen counter into frame. Preserve product identity exactly from the reference image: white curved plastic trigger spray bottle, wide lower body and narrow neck, white trigger nozzle, white ribbed collar below the trigger, glossy green front label, black NUAN logo near the top of the label, visible Heavy Duty Degreaser label area, small peach scent badge or peach icon, correct 500ml handheld proportions, smooth white plastic material. Do not change the bottle color, shape, label placement, material, proportions, or logo position. The hand sprays a realistic light foam coverage onto the same greasy range hood area, waits briefly, then wipes with a plain blue microfiber towel. Show real cleaning action as the towel lifts softened grease; no magical instant disappearance, no exaggerated bubbling, no smoke, no glowing chemical effects. Finish with a stable close-up proof from the same angle: the cleaned strip of metal looks brighter and less oily beside a still-visible uncleaned smeared section for credible before-after contrast. Add natural spoken UGC voiceover only, no on-screen text: 'I used to do this over and over. It just kept spreading. Then I switched to this. If your paper towel just spreads grease around, try this on the hood.' Forbid platform UI, subtitles, captions, stickers, text overlays, watermarks, sales banners, invented accessories, extra bottles, product drift, label redesign, floating product, impossible cleaning, or exaggerated chemical effects.
